subject.statement: Do Kwon was acquitted of all US fraud charges in 2025.

summary: Do Kwon was indicted by the US DOJ in July 2023 on fraud and related charges; as of 2026-10-01 there has been no public record of an acquittal or dismissal of those charges, and he remained awaiting extradition/trial. Therefore the claim that he was acquitted of all US fraud charges in 2025 is incorrect.
